# Binyan Eitan

> G1-licensed construction contractor specializing in complex project execution, luxury renovations, and structural engineering in Jerusalem and central Israel. Founded by Moti Eitan with over 20 years of hands-on engineering experience.

Binyan Eitan (בניין איתן) is a registered G1 contractor (#41805) based in Jerusalem. The company delivers precision engineering across residential, institutional, and commercial projects — from ground-up villa construction to complex structural renovations and premium interior finishes. The company serves clients in Jerusalem, Benjamin region, Mevasseret Zion, Gush Etzion, Beit Shemesh, and central Israel, including international clients managing projects remotely from abroad.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- G1 Contractor License #41805 — highest classification issued by Israel's Ministry of Construction and Housing
- Founder: Moti Eitan (מוטי איתן), registered engineer and contractor
- Specialties: structural engineering, luxury renovations, remote project management for diaspora clients, complex logistical construction
- Languages: Hebrew (primary), English
- Service area: Jerusalem, Benjamin, Mevasseret Zion, Gush Etzion, Beit Shemesh, Central Israel
- Notable project: Kiryat Amshinov — 100 tons of steel lifted over occupied buildings in 30 days
